scripts.codegen: pnpm run db:codegen && pnpm run db:codegen:mesh && pnpm run db:codegen:admin
scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --sourcemap --outDir dist --external kysely --external pg
scripts.dev: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --dts --sourcemap --outDir dist --watch --external kysely --external pg
scripts.prisma:pull: prisma db pull && python3 scripts/fix-prisma-relations.py && pnpm run prisma:generate
scripts.prisma:pull:mesh: node scripts/prisma-pull.mjs --target=mesh --schema src/prisma/schema.mesh.prisma && python3 scripts/fix-prisma-relations.py && pnpm run prisma:generate:mesh
scripts.prisma:pull:admin: node scripts/prisma-pull.mjs --target=admin --schema src/prisma/schema.admin.prisma && python3 scripts/fix-prisma-relations.py && pnpm run prisma:generate:admin
scripts.prisma:pull:force: prisma db pull --force && python3 scripts/fix-prisma-relations.py && pnpm run prisma:generate
